## Why

Describe the user problem and the behavior this change produces.

## Changes

List the changes a reviewer needs to understand. Explain changes to permissions, data handling, judging, or cost.

## Verification

List commands and outcomes. Explain skipped checks.

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python acceptance/run.py`
- [ ] Docs match the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Desktop changes include screenshots when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials or private conversation data are included.
